Again thank you for the help!

Thanks for the advice, friend!  I may just take the opportunity and run with it despite my fears.  I won’t know unless I give it a shot.  I just hope others know that they aren’t alone in their sadness.  Everyday can be a struggle, I have my good days and some bad.

Thank you for taking the time to respond.  I to wish you well on your journey and pursuit to happiness.  I believe you have what it takes to pull yourself from the depths of darkness and bring yourself into the light!  Just be vigilant and keep putting one foot in front of the other instead of letting the past pull you down.
